what_this_is: The Q66 class-rule table (owner ruling Q66, 2026-09-24, capx ledger §0bj: "Class rule."; executed by capx D93). One row per cache-key REGISTRATION of a ScenarioConfig field that had already landed unregistered. An UNLISTED committed run_config.json whose recorded cache_key does not reproduce is classified `lag` — REPORTED, not a failure — iff, for some row: (1) its payload CARRIES the field at its frozen drop value; (2) the row's registration_sha is NOT an ancestor of the record's recorded solve sha (git.sha, else git.basis_sha; no sha or a dirty tree fails this leg); and (3) scripts/lib/key_provenance.head_key(payload, undrop=(field,)) equals the recorded literal EXACTLY. Legs (1)+(2) without (3) FAIL as G1_LAG_NO_REPRODUCE. Statement and derivation: docs/handoffs/PRECOMMIT-capx-d93-2026-09-24.md §2.
what_this_is_not: NOT a place to park a mismatch. A row names a REGISTRATION COMMIT, never a record, and every record it covers must still reproduce its own literal exactly under the undrop — a row cannot excuse a record it does not derive. NOT a substitute for registering a field: the G6 gate still fails any unregistered field, and a row is added only by the lane that registers the field (or that diagnoses a registration's orphans by single-field experiment, as capx D93 did for caiso_dsw_lateevening_clean). NOT key-provenance-exceptions.json and NOT key-provenance-unregistered-baseline.json, neither of which may be appended to.
